nodes.description: State variable storing the block number used to derive the starting index for token reveal.
State variable holding the offset used to shuffle token metadata reveal.
State variable for the price (in wei) required to mint a single Doge.
State variable capping how many tokens can be minted in a single transaction.
State variable holding the maximum total token supply (10000).
State variable holding the timestamp after which reveal metadata can be set.
State variable toggling whether the public mint sale is open.
State variable holding the first payout address for withdrawals.
State variable holding the second payout address for withdrawals.
Public payable mint function; validates sale state, per-tx cap and supply, sends ETH value check and mints tokens.
Publicly callable function that computes startingIndex from blockhash; lacks owner restriction.
Owner-only function splitting the contract balance between wallet1 and wallet2 via transfer.
Owner-only function that mints a batch of tokens to a given address.
Owner-only setter for the mint price.
Owner-only setter for the per-transaction mint cap.
Owner-only function toggling saleIsActive.
Owner-only setter for the reveal timestamp.
Owner-only emergency function that sets startingIndexBlock to the current block number.
Caller-controlled address used as recipient of minted tokens.
Miner-influenced timestamp compared against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
Low-level ETH transfer performed on wallet1/wallet2 inside withdraw, transferring control to external addresses.
Use of blockhash(block.number) as a pseudo-random source for startingIndex, manipulable by miners.
Parameter of mintDoges specifying how many tokens the caller wishes to mint.
Local variable inside mintDoges holding the token id derived from totalSupply().
Parameter of reserveDoges specifying how many tokens the owner mints.
Parameter of setMintPrice specifying the new mint price.
Parameter of setMaxToMint specifying the new per-transaction cap.
Parameter of setRevealTimestamp specifying the new reveal timestamp.
Local variable in withdraw holding address(this).balance.
Local variable in withdraw holding 50% of the contract balance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the recipient to _safeMint inside mintDoges.
block.timestamp is compared against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to gate startingIndexBlock assignment, a timestamp-dependency.
numberOfTokens controls the loop iteration count and validation checks in mintDoges.
mintDoges reads mintPrice to compute the required msg.value.
mintDoges reads maxToMint to bound numberOfTokens per transaction.
mintDoges reads MAX_DOGE_SUPPLY to enforce the total supply cap.
mintDoges reads REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to decide when to set startingIndexBlock, a timestamp-dependency.
mintDoges writes to startingIndexBlock when the reveal condition is met.
mintIndex local variable feeds the token id passed to _safeMint in mintDoges.
blockhash result is used by setStartingIndex to compute startingIndex, a miner-manipulable random source.
setStartingIndex writes the computed value into startingIndex.
setStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock to derive the blockhash.
setStartingIndex uses MAX_DOGE_SUPPLY as the modulus for the starting index.
The blockhash-derived value is directly assigned to startingIndex without access restriction.
withdraw reads wallet1 as the first recipient of funds.
withdraw reads wallet2 as the second recipient of funds.
withdraw performs external ETH transfers to wallet1/wallet2, transferring control to external addresses before finishing logic.
Local balance variable reads the contract balance in withdraw.
Local walletBalance variable holds the computed split amount in withdraw.
_numberOfTokens drives the reserve minting loop in reserveDoges.
reserveDoges reads totalSupply related to MAX_DOGE_SUPPLY when computing mint indices.
_price parameter is written into mintPrice by setMintPrice.
setMintPrice modifies mintPrice via an onlyOwner restricted external function.
_maxValue parameter is written into maxToMint by setMaxToMint.
setMaxToMint modifies maxToMint via an onlyOwner restricted external function.
_revealTimeStamp parameter is written into REVEAL_TIMESTAMP by setRevealTimestamp.
setRevealTimestamp modifies REVEAL_TIMESTAMP via an onlyOwner restricted external function.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes block.number into startingIndexBlock.
setSaleState toggles saleIsActive via an onlyOwner restricted external function.
mintDoges reads saleIsActive to gate minting, an access-control condition.
withdraw assigns the contract balance to the local balance variable.
withdraw derives walletBalance from balance using mul and div.

normalization_plan.reason: numberOfTokens is a mintDoges parameter that only affects loop count and validation within that function.
mintIndex is a local temporary token id used only inside mintDoges.
_numberOfTokens is a reserveDoges parameter controlling only its minting loop.
_price is a setMintPrice parameter written directly into mintPrice.
_maxValue is a setMaxToMint parameter written directly into maxToMint.
_revealTimeStamp is a setRevealTimestamp parameter written directly into REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
balance is a local variable in withdraw holding the contract balance before splitting.
walletBalance is the local amount forwarded by the external transfer call in withdraw.
